title: Afterdeath
description: Die as a human, rise as a zombie - fight through infection stages, craft a cure, or steal bodies in PvP.
body: ![Afterdeath: Tides & Sands 0.6.0 Update Banner](https://i.ibb.co/ZRYSfZmx/0-6-0-logo.png) ## AFTERDEATH WIKI IS IN PROGRESS ## [![What's new in the mod](https://i.ibb.co/gZ7vzvpG/whats-new.png)](https://modrinth.com/mod/afterdeath/changelog) ## [![🐛 Official Discord Server (Bug Reports & Feature Requests)](https://i.ibb.co/TMqXFbmY/Discord-server-Bugs-and-feature-requests.png)](https://discord.gg/y5UXessNGT) ## ![Core Mechanic](https://i.ibb.co/VYxWpjFG/Core-Mechanic.png) ![a player fighting zombies and turning into a zombie](https://i.ibb.co/k2gbQhKY/getting-infected.gif) When you die, you rise again as a zombie player. Your inventory drops, your abilities change, and you must find a way to cure yourself - or embrace the undead life. ## ![Infection System](https://i.ibb.co/8401L3rC/Infection-System.png) - Getting hit by zombies or cave spiders gradually **infects** you. - Infection progresses through **3 stages** with increasing debuffs. - **Dynamic HUD:** A custom on-screen progress bar and fullscreen tint will visually track your exact infection percentage. - At 100% (Infection Stage III), you **transform into a zombie player**. - Entering Infected Water or standing on infected blocks will actively inflict Poison and Nausea. - You can eat **Totem Shards** or **Golden Apples** to reduce infection. - Beware of **Infected Water** and **over 450 new Infected Block variants** spreading through the environment. - **The Gas Zombie:** A dangerous hostile zombie variant that spits toxic projectiles and leaves lingering infected gas clouds upon death. - Submerging vanilla mobs in Infected Water for 15 seconds will cause them to violently shake and mutate into their undead variants: - _Zombies > Drowned_ - _Husks > Zombies_ - _Villagers > Zombie Villagers_ - _Piglins > Zombified Piglins_ - _Horses > Zombie Horses_ ## ![Rusty Iron Stuff](https://i.ibb.co/sdS6C7W0/Rusty-Iron-Stuff.png) ![Rusty iron items](https://i.ibb.co/S7BfRsbH/rusty-iron-stuff-0-5-5.jpg) Toss vanilla iron items into **Infected Water** to create the new **Rusty Iron** set (Armor, Tools, Shears, Blocks, Buckets, Doors, Trapdoors, Bars, Horse Armor, Shields, Lanterns, and Chains). - Rusty tools inflict Poison on mobs and Infection on players. Rusty Armor acts like Thorns, infecting attackers (but it slowly infects the wearer too). - Rusty Armor and Tools can be fully repaired in an anvil using Rusty Iron Ingots. (The Rusty Shield, which fully supports Banner Patterns, is repaired with Infected Planks). - Rusty Horse Armor provides the exact same Thorns (infection/poison) counter-attack effect as player Rusty Armor. - Harvesting any infected block in Survival mode strictly requires using the correct matching Rusty Iron tool. - Slaying a Gas Zombie specifically with a Rusty tool completely prevents it from releasing its toxic gas cloud. - Rusty Buckets instantly convert normal water into Infected Water upon scooping. (Just don't try to scoop lava with one). ## ![Cleansing](https://i.ibb.co/S483qkrR/Cleansing.png) ![a player throwing a Splash Potion of Holiness at a patch of Infected Blocks](https://i.ibb.co/VZsncY1/curing-blockz.gif) - **Splash Potion of Holiness:** A brand new brewable item. Craft it by placing a Totem Shard and Splash Water Bottles into a Brewing Stand. - When thrown, it instantly cures infected blocks and water within a 4-block radius, fully cures players in the early infection stages, and acts as a Super Fertilizer on crops. - Hitting fully-turned Zombie or Skeleton players drops them to half a heart and applies a massive "Stun" debuff (Slowness, Weakness, and Glowing) - making them vulnerable to a Forced Cure. - Sponges can absorb Infected Water, turning into Wet Infected Sponges (which can be dried by smelting). ## ![Built-in World Converter](https://i.ibb.co/FqfQbrgF/World-Converter.png) ![clicking the Convert World button in the config screen, showing a progress bar, and then logging into a world to see the infection gone](https://i.ibb.co/GvTgNwC8/world-converter.gif) You can use the built-in **World Converter** directly from the mod's Config Screen. With one click, the tool will automatically create a safe backup of your save file, scan your entire world, and restore all infected blocks and water back to their normal vanilla states. ## ![Structures](https://i.ibb.co/Kj91xPBS/Structures.png) ![Graveyard and an Infected Lake](https://i.ibb.co/srJdcBp/structureslow.png) - **Infected Lake:** A highly dangerous, naturally generating source of Infected Water. (Can generate in all biomes except Mushroom Island) - **Graveyard:** Brave the dangers to find unique loot chests hidden inside ancient **Coffins**. (Can generate in all biomes except Mushroom Island) ## ![Zombie Forms](https://i.ibb.co/5gBk5Wnk/Zombie-Forms.png) - **Burn in sunlight**. - **Night vision** in darkness. - **Hostile mobs ignore you** (before you touch them). - You cannot sprint during the day unless in darkness, rain, or thunder. - **Limited inventory** (left and right hands). - **Raw meat heals more**, cooked food is worse. - **Iron Golems & Snow Golems attack** you. - **Villagers and Wandering Traders flee** from you. - Breathe underwater. - Killing a Villager, Horse, Piglin, or Wandering Trader will instantly convert them into their undead variant. - As you rot, you gain massive combat resistance against players and mobs, but become significantly more vulnerable to sunlight and fall damage. ## ![Drowned & Husk Forms](https://i.ibb.co/fGxjcS3D/NEW-Drowned-Husk-Forms.png) ![drowned and husk players](https://i.ibb.co/Z1dSxg3t/drowned-and-husk.png) ## ![Drowned](https://i.ibb.co/Q3J7gJn6/NEW-Drowned.png) ###### Fresh Drowned -> Rotting Drowned -> Bloated Drowned -> Bogged - Gain an underwater navigation speed buff (Fresh +20%, Rotting +40%, Bloated +50%, togglable). - Your thrown tridents never lose durability and automatically gain a returning loyalty effect (no enchantment required, togglable). - You are highly sensitive to solar heat, taking increased damage under the sun (Fresh 1.25x, Rotting 1.5x, Bloated 2.0x, togglable). - Reach the final **Bogged** stage to grow mushrooms directly on your head! Other players can shear you for red and brown mushrooms, starting a 10-minute regrowth timer. ## ![Husk](https://i.ibb.co/27jcVgw2/NEW-Husk.png) ###### Fresh Husk -> Rotting Husk -> Mummified Husk -> Parched - You are entirely immune to burning under direct sunlight. - Your melee attacks inflict Hunger on your targets (configurable duration). - You drown 3x faster, receive Slowness II when submerged in water, and receive Slowness I when standing in rain (togglable). - Reaching the **Mummified Husk** stage grants you a permanent 75% reduction to all fire damage. ## ![Fluid-Based Mutability & Drying](https://i.ibb.co/TMV3Y6J4/NEW-Fluid-Mutability-Drying.png) - **The Drying Bar:** A new progress bar. It fills up whenever a Zombie player stands in dry biomes (Deserts, Badlands, Savannas, Nether) or when a Drowned player is out of water and rain. Standing in water or rain instantly empties it. - **Heat Mutations:** - If a **Drowned** player dries out completely (reaches 100% on the Drying Bar) or takes fatal sun damage, they revert to their corresponding tier of **Zombie**. - If a **Zombie** player reaches 100% on the Drying Bar in a hot/dry biome, they bake into their corresponding tier of **Husk**. - **Submergence Mutations:** - If a **Zombie** player runs out of air and drowns, they transform into their corresponding tier of **Drowned**. - If a **Husk** player runs out of air and drowns, they hydrate and convert back into their corresponding tier of **Zombie**. ## ![Skeleton Forms](https://i.ibb.co/ZpdQRGXv/Skeleton-Forms.png) ![skeleton, bogged, parched and wither skeleton](https://i.ibb.co/v6JTkXWf/skeleton-bogged-parched-and-wither-skeleton.png) - Skeletons don't need to eat. Instead, you heal yourself by right-clicking with **Bones**. - You have infinite arrows and your bows/crossbows will **never** take durability damage. - Because you have no eyes, you can safely stare at Endermen without angering them. - Reach the final stage to become **100% immune to fire and lava**, inflict the Wither effect on melee hits, heal from the Wither effect, and never take sword durability damage. - Blazes are highly aggressive toward all undead players _except_ Wither Skeletons, which they will treat as neutral Nether allies. - **[NEW!]** **Nether Ascension:** Skeletons are born of cold earth, but forged in fire. Surviving as a Parched, Bogged, or standard Skeleton in the **Nether for 30 minutes** will permanently mutate you into a **Wither Skeleton**. - **[NEW!]** **Specialized Ammo:** When your inventory is completely empty of arrows, shooting bows as a **Bogged** skeleton will fire Poison arrows, and as a **Parched** skeleton will fire Weakness arrows. ## ![Undead Minions](https://i.ibb.co/LXJCfhxs/Undead-Minions.png) ![Left: a skeleton player riding a spider as it climbs upwards. Right: a zombie player riding a zombie horse](https://i.ibb.co/LzTnB1kc/Left-a-skeleton-player-riding-a-spider-as-it-climbs-upwards-Right-a-zombie-player-riding-a-zombie-h.gif) As a fully decomposed undead, you are a commander of the horde. - Old Zombie players can tame other zombie-type mobs using Rotten Flesh, while Wither Skeleton players can tame skeleton-type mobs using Bones. - Tamed undead will follow and defend you. Skeleton arrows will pass harmlessly through you and your other minions. _(Note: Tamed mobs automatically untame if you transition forms or are cured)._ - Zombie players can tame and ride Zombie Horses using Rotten Flesh, and Skeleton players can tame and ride Skeleton Horses using Bones (A saddle is also required to ride them). - Skeleton players can tame, ride, and actually steer Spiders (and Cave Spiders, if enabled in config). ## ![Self Cure Ritual](https://i.ibb.co/6cNJz95g/Self-Cure-Ritual.png) ![curing myself](https://i.ibb.co/FLPvYnLk/healing-myself.gif) 1. Get the **Weakness** effect (splash potion or any other item that gives a Weakness effect). 2. Eat a **Golden Apple**. 3. Eat the **Heart of Life**. ## ![PvP Forced Curing](https://i.ibb.co/zHQxbxM9/Pv-P-Forced-Curing.png) Human players can now forcefully cure an undead player in combat. - **Zombie Curing:** Humans can throw a Splash Potion of Holiness to "stun" a Zombie Player, then right-click them with a Golden Apple to cure them. The newly cured player receives massive survival buffs (Regeneration II and Absorption I) to help them escape. - **Skeleton Surgery:** Once stunned with holy water, humans must right-click them with **24 Rotten Flesh** to rebuild their body limb-by-limb, before finally applying the Golden Apple. ## ![PvP Body Stealing](https://i.ibb.co/DHn0vsLG/Pv-P-Body-Stealing.png) ![turning other player into zombie.gif](https://i.ibb.co/SbmQ85T/infecting-another-player.gif) Zombie players can steal the body of living players they kill in PvP - curing themselves (by 50%) while zombifying the victim. ## ![Advancements](https://i.ibb.co/Vbv7sbx/Advancements.png) A massive, new advancement tree containing **38 advancements**. Unlock milestones for surviving as a zombie, crafting Rusty Iron gear, stealing bodies, acting as a **Field Surgeon**, raising an **Army of the Dead**, or crafting specialized survival gear. ## ![Sack](https://i.ibb.co/Kn03yZD/Sack.png) ![The player crafts a sack and wears it](https://i.ibb.co/NdXgbwKM/The-player-crafts-a-sack-and-wears-it.gif) A unique equipment item that **expands your hotbar by 3 extra slots** when worn as a chestplate. Items persist inside the sack when unequipped. Can be crafted with 7 rabbit/normal leather and 1 string. You can use the `0`, `-` and `=` to access the extra slots quickly. The Sack can be dyed into all **16 different colors** (your items will safely transfer over when re-dyeing). ## ![Mod Settings](https://i.ibb.co/fGG0xgTJ/Mod-settings.png) ![all mod settings](https://i.ibb.co/wvNG7pr/mod-settings.gif) **111 server-side options** and **15 client-side options**. Toggle every single feature, adjust damage multipliers, customize UI elements and more. Added a built-in **Search Bar** to instantly find any setting by name, description, or value. Accessible directly from the **Vanilla Pause Menu** and right before you **Create a New World**. You can even create and assign **unique server configuration profiles for each individual world**. **Admin & Compatibility Features:** - Includes custom `//infect` and `//cure` commands (with full undo/redo support) to easily corrupt or purify massive world selections at once (only when WorldEdit is installed). - **[NEW!]** Includes `/zombie`, updated `/skeleton` command, and brand-new `/drowned` and `/husk` developer utility commands. ## ![Languages](https://i.ibb.co/R4GJb62R/Languages.png)  _(More coming in next versions)_ - English - German - Spanish - French - Japanese - Korean - Polish - Portuguese - Russian - Ukrainian - Chinese
